value.text: CodeRabbit round on dd85aee, fixed by hand. validate_scalar_owner now receives the caller principal from its call sites: native update and comment resolve caller_principal(author), which includes the scoped session, while prepare_update_preview passes the batch author only. Previews therefore never inherit an ambient AuthorIdentity, as the AdmissionBatch.author contract states. New test preview_ownership_ignores_an_ambient_scoped_identity: inside alpha's scope, a batch by intruder is refused with ownership_conflict, and alpha's own batch is admitted without a scope. It fails on revert (0/1). CI now sets CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 (CodeRabbit's outside-diff note). fmt, clippy -D warnings (all targets) and changelog-check pass; lib 382, admission 11, claim/release differential 27, close differential 6, mutation 29, ownership 11.

value.author: claude-hub
value.text: CodeRabbit round on df8012c (2 minor), fixed by hand. (1) New public AdmissionPreview::with_input_bytes replaces the canonical count and re-measures JSON and TOON against output_bytes. The CLI calls it inside the existing preview refusal boundary (one ?), so a stdin count with more digits can no longer push a receipt over 65,536 bytes. New test admission_input_byte_replacement_rechecks_the_output_ceiling binary-searches a receipt just under the ceiling and shows a 16-digit count is refused; it fails without the re-check (0/1). (2) The Windows source pin now opens ancestors with FILE_SHARE_READ|WRITE (delete still denied, so an ancestor cannot be renamed or replaced, while writers may link or rename children) and the leaf with FILE_SHARE_READ|DELETE (a native rename replacement succeeds; in-place writes stay blocked during the bounded read). New Windows-only test windows_source_pin_allows_child_links_and_leaf_replacement; it runs only on Windows CI and cross-compiled cleanly for x86_64-pc-windows-gnu. fmt, clippy -D warnings (native and Windows target), changelog-check; lib 382, admission 12, cli_dispatch 17.
